# Wreaken Mining

## Biography

Wreaken Mining is a mining concern active in the 34th century, possibly linked to the heavy-construction contractor Wreaken Construction. In August 3312 the company's chief geologist, Dr. Ben Curtis, published research arguing that conventional laser and refinery processes waste valuable minerals because of their large-scale inefficiencies. Curtis proposed introducing a modulating waveform and tighter beam focus into a more compact laser housing, allowing planetary surfaces to be mined for resources that were previously unobtainable. Wreaken Mining was reportedly already manufacturing new deployable laser drills and refinery modules based on the research, as well as modifications to Detailed Surface Scanners that could detect the new mining locations from orbit. Freelance journalist Adalyn Cross, reviewing the research for Vox Galactica, reported that industry contacts anticipated a new surface-mining boom.
